history.summary: NON-TEMPLE INSTITUTION FLAG: Bihar Yoga Bharati is not a conventional temple - it is an Institute for Advanced Studies in Yogic Sciences located at the Yoga Vidya Campus, Munger (near the Munger Fort, at Karna Chaura, on the Ganga). Founded in 1994 by Swami Niranjanananda Saraswati, it was established along the lines of Nalanda and Vikramshila to preserve and regenerate yogic science through academic and scientific methodology with a spiritual vision; it is co-located with Ganga Darshan Vishwa Yogapeeth (5.5 hectares). It is the sister institution of the Bihar School of Yoga (founded 1963 by Swami Satyananda Saraswati) and of Sivananda Math. It offers ashram-based residential courses in yoga, Vedanta and allied subjects (it once operated as a deemed university) and is the base of the Satyananda Yoga tradition with the Yoga Publications Trust. Visitors participate as course students/guests, not as temple pilgrims - keep-or-drop decision needed for a Hindu temples list. name: Bihar Yoga Bharati Temple
town_description: Munger is an ancient city in eastern Bihar on the south bank of the Ganges, once the capital of the Anga kingdom and later of Mir Qasim; the Munger Fort and the Ganga-side Yoga Vidya campus (Karna Chaura) anchor its identity as a seat of both history and yoga. It lies about 175 km east of Patna.
tradition: Hinduism (Yoga - Satyananda tradition of Sanatana Dharma)
